task.question: How many people were killed in the Guerrero earthquake on January 2, 2026?
task.evidence: 2 January – A magnitude 6.5 earthquake hits Guerrero, killing two people.

messages.content: You solve tasks. If you need to calculate or look up a fact, call tools instead of guessing. When the answer is ready, write it as the last line in the format FINAL: <answer>. For numeric tasks put only the number after FINAL, for factual questions a short phrase.
How many people were killed in the Guerrero earthquake on January 2, 2026?

[2026 Guerrero earthquake] On 2 January 2026, at 07:58:18 local time (13:58:18 UTC), a Mw 6.5 earthquake struck near San Marcos in the Mexican state of Guerrero. The earthquake occurred at a depth of 18 kilometres (11 mi). Two people were killed, twenty-four others were injured and hundreds of buildings were damaged as a result of the earthquake.
